name: iching-divination
title_zh: 三枚铜钱真随机，卦象不靠编
tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
desc_en: 真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation
why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.
limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
title_en: Real coin-toss I Ching, no made-up hexagrams
